items.quote: You are losing at least 50% of your commission… If you do not use a sales script.
items.statement: You are losing at least 50% of your commission… If you do not use a sales script.

items.quote: The ONLY thing separating top salespeople from the rest is - A.) Their SALES SCRIPT and B.) Their ability to wield it with SKILL.
items.statement: The ONLY thing separating top salespeople from the rest is - A.) Their SALES SCRIPT and B.) Their ability to wield it with SKILL.

items.quote: If your SALES SCRIPT triggers ‘sales resistance’ in prospects… Then you’ll struggle to even stay average.
items.statement: If your SALES SCRIPT triggers ‘sales resistance’ in prospects… Then you’ll struggle to even stay average - let alone crack the entry point to the Top 1% of salespeople.

items.quote: You should not only understand and memorise the script you should become the script.
items.statement: You should not only understand and memorise the script; you should become the script.

items.quote: HOW? - Give yourself 3-4 months at least to practise and rehearse every day.
items.statement: Give yourself 3-4 months at least to practise and rehearse every day.

items.quote: Record your conversations and review them, noticing your words, tone, and the prospect’s reaction.
items.statement: Record your conversations and review them, noticing your words, tone, and the prospect’s reaction.

items.quote: Role-play with a colleague or a friend.
items.statement: Role-play with a colleague or a friend.
